ShortDescription.Value: See every district's happiness, top complaint, assigned services, assets, and active policies at a glance

Publish.LongDescription:
**District Manager** adds a map-pin button to the toolbar that opens a panel listing every district in your city, all in one place.
For each district, at a glance: - **Population** and **average citizen happiness** (color-coded) - The single **biggest complaint** currently affecting that district - **Services** actually assigned to it - only buildings you've explicitly restricted to that district with the game's own "assign district" tool, not just anything physically nearby - **Assets** located in the district - parks and signature/landmark buildings - **Policies** currently active in that district
Districts are listed alphabetically and start collapsed - expand one, or use Expand All / Collapse All. Click the pin next to a district name, or any service/asset chip, to jump the camera straight to it on the map. A manual refresh button forces an update on demand, and the mod can be toggled on/off any time from Options > Mods > District Manager.
Read-only: it only displays existing city data and never changes how your city plays. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save at any time.
